## Suggest an event or correction

You do not need to edit repository files. Use the guided issue forms to [suggest a conference or event](https://github.com/Nordic-Accessibility-Community-Group/en-301-549-resources-and-eaa-monitoring/issues/new?template=conference-addition.yml) or [report a correction](https://github.com/Nordic-Accessibility-Community-Group/en-301-549-resources-and-eaa-monitoring/issues/new?template=conference-correction.yml). Maintainers will review the official source before changing the calendar.

Technical contributors can read [the conference data guide](data/README.md) before opening a pull request.
